verdict.rationale: The docs confirm multiple concurrent shells: a two-finger tap creates a new shell, side swipes switch between them, and a tab bar can create or close tabs. Themes and fonts are configurable, but the evidence describes this as app-level styling, not per-session. Missing for 10: evidence that each session keeps its own appearance, per-session command history, an explicit description of isolated per-session context, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-session workflows.
